body_markdown:
"There is no way to truly prepare yourself for the moment you have to dial 911 for your baby.


On June 19th, our sweet baby girl’s oxygen levels suddenly dropped below 75% within seconds. Everything had been completely normal. We were simply getting ready for bed like any other night when, out of nowhere, our[Owlet Dream Sock](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=OwletStory) started alarming.


It didn’t just alarm once—it went off over 15 times. Every single time we tried to settle ourselves, it would alert us again. Those alarms are what helped us know something was seriously wrong before we ever would have known on our own.


When EMS arrived, they immediately hooked her up to their monitors, and their equipment confirmed what our Dream Sock had alerted us about. In that moment, all I could think about was getting my baby help as fast as possible.


As terrifying as that night was, I truly believe our Dream Sock gave us the chance to act immediately. Without it, we may not have realized anything was wrong until much later.


After living through this firsthand, I can honestly say I wouldn’t trade our Dream Sock for the world. It gave us the warning we desperately needed and helped us get our daughter the care she needed.


I’m beyond grateful for the paramedics, nurses, doctors, and everyone who took such amazing care of our little girl. Most of all, I’m thankful that she’s here with us today." - Lanie M.


Share your Owlet story[here](https://owletcare.com/pages/share-your-story?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=OwletStory) .


**As a reminder, Dream Sock® is intended to track your baby's pulse rate and oxygen level and keep parents informed, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease or other condition including, but not limited to, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) and/or Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). This story reflects one family's experience. Individual experiences may vary.*
